title: Hello
description: Response of GET /v1/hello (capability handshake, DRAFT). 200 means the app is up; clients cache the result (PHP: temp file shared by all workers, 30-60 s).

instance.description: Random per app start; a change tells clients the app restarted (drop cached locks)

features.description: e.g. batch, locks.wait, values.v1, ops.append, gzip, zstd, watchers.remote

watchers.description: Remote-controlled watcher switches (note 02 §15.2). Keys are client-defined watcher names.

redact.description: Extra key patterns the client must mask before sending

paused.description: App-side ingest pause; clients may skip expensive capture while true
